name: com.evernote.android.job.patched.internal.v21.PlatformJobService
description: When Android's job scheduler reports a task is due, the patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit runs it through this Service; MapKit uses these jobs for offline-map downloads.
disableEffect: Yandex MapKit offline-map downloads scheduled through Android's job scheduler will not run.
